segments.label: THE MOMENT
segments.title:
Friday is coming.
The slides are not.
segments.body: How do you start the conversation?
segments.text: Your teammate's slides are late. The presentation is Friday. How do you start that conversation?

segments.label: PREVIEW • RECORDED COMPARISON
segments.title:
Same moment.
Different words.
segments.text: Second Take lets you rehearse, rewind, and see what a different choice changes.

segments.label: 01 / FIRST ATTEMPT
segments.title:
Start with
a concern.
segments.body:
“I am worried about the project”

Alex: “What do you mean exactly?”
segments.text: I tell Alex I am worried about the project. Alex asks what I mean. My concern needs clarification.

segments.label: 02 / REWIND
segments.title:
Go back to
the same moment.
segments.body:
Same facts. Same history.
Same conversation state.
segments.text: Now I rewind. The app restores the checkpoint before that choice, with the same facts and conversation history.

segments.label: CHECKPOINT RESTORED
segments.title:
Change one thing:
your choice.
segments.body: A second attempt from the preserved context.
segments.text: Everything before the checkpoint stays fixed. This time, I make a specific request.

segments.label: 03 / SECOND ATTEMPT
segments.title:
“Can you
finish today?”
segments.body: A capability question — or a request?
segments.text: Can you finish today? That could be a question about ability, or a request to act.

segments.label: INTENT LOCK • DETAIL INSERT
segments.title:
Your intention.
Your decision.
segments.body:
Find out if Alex can finish

or ask Alex to finish.
segments.text: Intent Lock lets me confirm which I mean, instead of letting the model guess.

segments.label: 04 / OBSERVE THE RESPONSE
segments.title:
A specific
commitment.
segments.body:
Alex: “I can finish the sources
by nine tonight.”
segments.text: Alex now commits to finishing the sources by nine tonight. That is an observable difference.

segments.title:

Compare next.
segments.body:
The conversation, rewind and
second attempt are free.
segments.text: Both attempts are free. The premium comparison puts the choices and immediate responses together.

segments.label: 05 / COMPARE
segments.title:
What actually
changed?
segments.body:
A: a request for clarification.

B: a commitment with a time.

The app shows the words behind each outcome.
segments.text: One message led to clarification. The other led to a specific commitment. I can inspect both without relying on memory.

segments.label: BUILT WITH CARE
segments.title:
Flexible language.
Bounded actions.
segments.body:
Gemini interprets and selects.
Policy limits the available actions.
Alex's replies are authored.
segments.text: Gemini interprets language and selects allowed actions. Policy and authored replies keep the scenario consistent.
